about: The pathway database. Edit it freely in any text editor; the program reads it on start.
Write each ability as "Name: what it does". Movement powers are ordinary abilities of the Sequence that unlocks them.
Descriptions are short summaries in our own words. Higher-Sequence powers are pieced together from fan sources
and are best-effort: correct anything you know better.
To add a pathway, copy a whole { ... } block below, give it a new unique id, and change its fields.
primaryStat / secondaryStat: STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS or CHA. speedGrade: Slow, Average, Fast or Very fast.

sequences.name: Seer
abilities: Spirit Vision: Sees auras, emotions, health and spirits that ordinary eyes miss.
Divination: Answers questions through dowsing rods, pendulums, dreams, mirrors, cards and similar methods.
Danger Intuition: Feels a vague warning when threats or bad omens are drawing near.
Mystic Aptitude: Gains a sharper memory, stronger spirituality and a natural knack for rituals.

sequences.name: Clown
abilities: Acrobatics: Gains superb balance, agility and body control for leaps, flips and dodges.
Poker Face: Keeps expressions and bodily reactions calm and unreadable, even under pressure.
Combat Intuition: Senses an incoming attack a split second before it lands.
Paper Blades: Hardens playing cards or paper so they can be thrown or swung like knives.

sequences.name: Magician
abilities: Paper Figurine Substitute: Swaps places with a paper figure to escape a lethal blow or blunt a curse.
Flaming Jump: Steps into one fire and out of another flame nearby.
Air Bullet: Snaps a finger to fire a compressed burst of air with gun-like force.
Illusions: Creates convincing false sights and sounds to mislead onlookers.
Escape Artistry: Softens bones and joints to slip out of ropes, cuffs and tight spots.
Damage Transfer: Shifts an injury away from vital organs to a less dangerous place.

sequences.name: Faceless
abilities: Shapeshifting: Reshapes face, body, voice and scent to become someone else, within limits of size.
Perfect Mimicry: Copies a person's looks, mannerisms and habits convincingly after studying them.
Face Memory: Remembers faces precisely and recognizes familiar people through their disguises.

sequences.name: Marionettist
abilities: Spirit Body Threads: Sees and grasps the invisible threads linking every being to its spirit body.
Marionette Control: Slows a victim through their threads until they become an obedient marionette that keeps its powers.
Marionette Swap: Instantly trades places with one of its marionettes within range.
Remote Bodies: Acts, speaks and fights through its marionettes as if they were extra bodies.

sequences.name: Bizarro Sorcerer
abilities: Bizarro Body: Becomes a demigod with an eerie, partly inhuman body of spirit worms that is very hard to kill.
Spirit World Shortcut: Briefly passes through the Spirit World to cover distance, and flame jumps reach much farther.
Marionette Legion: Commands dozens of marionettes and can use its own powers through worms planted in them.
Information Concealment: Hides facts about itself from divination and prying senses.
Beast Forms: Transforms into animals.
Wound Transfer: Moves its injuries or illnesses onto paper figures.

sequences.name: Scholar of Yore
abilities: Historical Projection: Summons temporary projections of people or objects it knows out of history.
Past Self: Borrows the state or strength of an earlier version of itself.
Historical Void: Enters the fog of history and hides inside gaps in the past.

sequences.name: Miracle Invoker
abilities: Wish Granting: Makes wishes come true within limits, with bigger miracles needing many gathered wishes.
Miracle Feats: Restores what was lost, moves things, reshapes an area, extends life or briefly suppresses powers.
Angelic Form: Completes its mythical creature form and becomes an angel.

sequences.name: Attendant of Mysteries
abilities: Grafting: Links things that have no real connection, joining places, effects, definitions or concepts.
Realm of Mysteries: Wraps an area in mystery, hiding it and cutting it off from the outside.
Thread Restoration: Gives spirit body threads back to things that once had them, and makes marionettes rapidly.
Direct Miracles: Performs miracles directly instead of waiting on accumulated wishes.

sequences.name: Fool
abilities: Fooling: Deceives senses, thought, history, fate and even reality, so a false condition can become true.
Lord of Mysteries: Holds authority over mysteries, the hidden and the unknown.
Perfected Powers: Grafting, miracles, history, marionettes and divination all reach full divine strength.

sequences.name: Apprentice
abilities: Door Opening: Draws a symbolic door on a wall or thin barrier and walks through it.
Unlocking: Opens ordinary locks and doors with ease.
Slip Restraints: Opens cuffs, ropes and other bindings to slip free.
Ritual Basics: Learns basic mysticism and simple ritual magic.

sequences.name: Trickmaster
abilities: Minor Tricks: Casts many small spells such as flashes, fog, darkness, freezing, sparks, shocks, gusts and loud bangs.
Slippery Ground: Makes a patch of floor slick so enemies stumble.
Small Telekinesis: Roughly nudges or moves light objects from a distance.
Escape Trick: Chains tricks together to dart over ten meters away almost instantly.

sequences.name: Astrologer
abilities: Astrology: Divines through star charts, celestial symbols and crystal balls.
Fate Reading: Reads looming fate and danger, with sharper spiritual intuition.
Memory Recall: Recovers blurred or forgotten memories.
Disguise Insight: Recognizes the same person beneath different disguises.
Divination Interference: Disrupts others' divination and intuition aimed at it.
Shared Door: Brings companions through walls and opens tiny peepholes to spy through.

sequences.name: Scribe
abilities: Recording: Records an active Beyonder power it witnesses and saves it for one later use, weaker if the source is stronger.
Recorded Library: Stores several recorded powers at once, with room growing as the potion digests.

sequences.name: Traveler
abilities: Traveler's Door: Opens a door into the Spirit World and steps out far away, carrying anyone it touches.
Blink: Teleports a short distance in an instant.
Spirit World Bearings: Always knows its position and finds its way within the Spirit World.
Invisible Hand: Grabs objects from a distance with an unseen hand.
Spirit Veil: Partly hides itself by drawing close to the Spirit World.

sequences.name: Secrets Sorcerer
abilities: Concealed Space: Creates hidden pocket spaces behind secret doors, used as prisons, vaults, safe rooms or arenas.
Secret Keeping: Hides secrets and conversations from divination, intuition and eavesdroppers.
Door Body: Turns into layers of illusory doors to slip past attacks.
Exile: Temporarily banishes a target into turbulent space.
Star Worm Form: Becomes a demigod with an incomplete Worm of Star mythical form.

sequences.name: Wanderer
abilities: Astral Wandering: Travels through the Astral World to distant planets and other dimensions.
Space Integration: Blends into surrounding space to hide and survive hostile environments.
Space Tearing: Rips space on contact, collapsing matter and the area into a spatial storm.
Spatial Cage: Turns concealed spaces into prisons that hold powerful enemies.
Barrier Breaking: Door Opening can now force through most barriers.

sequences.name: Planeswalker
abilities: Planar Travel: Teleports to far planets, dreams, the Mirror World, the Underworld and hidden spaces.
Symbol Form: Turns into symbols to cross the Astral World efficiently.
Dimension Sight: Views distant scenes across space.
Miniaturization: Shrinks people, objects or whole areas into toy-sized spaces.
Replication: Reproduces Beyonder powers it has seen without recording them first.
Sealing: Seals beings, powers and even concepts, including inside prisons of starlight.

sequences.name: Key of Stars
abilities: Starry Gateway: Opens doors from almost anywhere into the Astral World and the starry sky.
Stellar Positioning: Pinpoints nearly any place or being while keeping its own location hidden.
Stellar Gravity: Uses star-like gravity to bend, crack and crush space.
Starry Banishment: Casts enemies into the remote starry sky, far from any easy return.

sequences.name: Door
abilities: Supreme Positioning: Finds almost anything while making its own position impossible to locate.
Authority of Doors: Governs space, sealing, entrances, exits, boundaries and alternate worlds.
Instant Passage: Moves instantly between the physical, spirit and astral worlds.
Star Gravity: Bends and shatters space, distorts time and redirects light.
Absolute Sealing: Seals, or breaks seals on, beings, abilities, connections and even rules.

sequences.name: Marauder
abilities: Theft: Lifts items from pockets, bags and bodies without the owner noticing.
Nimble Hands: Gains fast, precise hands and quick reflexes.
Keen Eye: Spots valuables, hiding places and openings for a theft.

sequences.name: Swindler
abilities: Deceit: Tells persuasive lies that briefly bend a target's thinking toward believing them.
Silver Tongue: Gains eloquence and charm that make people listen and trust.
Misdirection: Draws attention away from its hands and its real goals.

sequences.name: Cryptologist
abilities: Decryption: Breaks codes, ciphers and secret writing with ease.
Pattern Sight: Spots hidden patterns, contradictions and clues that others overlook.
Flaw Finding: Perceives weak points in people, defenses, rituals and seals.

sequences.name: Prometheus
abilities: Power Theft: Steals a Beyonder ability from a nearby target and can use it for a short time.
Borrowed Fire: Turns a stolen power against its owner or others while the theft lasts.

sequences.name: Dream Stealer
abilities: Intent Theft: Steals a target's thought or intention, so they forget what they meant to do.
Memory Theft: Takes memories from a target, learning what they knew.
Dream Theft: Steals into dreams to take secrets and ideas.

sequences.name: Parasite
abilities: Parasitism: Lodges inside another being to hide, watch through them or control them from within.
Worm Avatars: Splits off small worm-like bodies that parasitize others and act as its avatars.
Time Worm Form: Becomes a demigod with an incomplete Worm of Time form that is very hard to wipe out.

sequences.name: Mentor of Deceit
abilities: Loophole Exploit: Finds and abuses gaps in rules, contracts, seals and even natural laws.
Deceive the Rules: Tricks the world's rules into accepting a false situation as valid.
Induced Errors: Nudges enemies and their powers into small but costly mistakes.

sequences.name: Trojan Horse of Destiny
abilities: Fate Theft: Steals parts of another's fate, taking their luck, role or future for itself.
Fate Parasitism: Hides inside a target's destiny, waiting to seize it at the right moment.
Fate Swap: Exchanges destinies between two people, or between itself and another.

sequences.name: Worm of Time
abilities: Time Theft: Steals moments of time from others, skipping or erasing what they would have done.
Time Parasitism: Lodges itself within time and others' timelines, making it extremely hard to kill.
Countless Avatars: Splits into many Worms of Time, each a capable avatar.

sequences.name: Error
abilities: Authority of Error: Rules over loopholes, mistakes and deceit, making rules and powers fail.
Absolute Theft: Can steal almost anything, from objects and powers to fate, time and concepts.
Deceiving the World: Fools reality itself into treating false or impossible situations as real.

pathways.name: Spectator
pathways.group: Visionary / Sun / Tyrant / White Tower / Hanged Man

sequences.name: Spectator
abilities: Keen Observation: Reads body language, expressions and habits to infer emotions and intentions.
Quiet Observer: Watches from the sidelines while drawing little attention to itself.
Sharp Mind: Gains better memory, deduction, eyesight and emotional control.

sequences.name: Telepathist
abilities: Surface Thoughts: Senses a person's current thoughts and feelings.
Thought Prediction: Simulates how a person is likely to think and react next.
Lie Sense: Notices lies and hidden reactions through spiritual perception.
Natural Rapport: Knows which words and expressions will feel natural to a given audience.

sequences.name: Psychiatrist
abilities: Placate: Calms fear, madness and the early signs of losing control.
Frenzy: Inflames emotions into rage or madness, harming mind and spirit.
Awe: Fills a target with dread or submission.
Psychological Cue: Plants a suggestion that the target believes is their own decision.
Mind Contact: Reaches into a mind that is partly open to it.

sequences.name: Hypnotist
abilities: Hypnosis: Hypnotizes a person, a group or itself, leaving instructions that act later unnoticed.
Battle Hypnosis: Makes foes hesitate, retreat, grow confused or attack their allies.
Psychological Invisibility: Becomes a blind spot that observers' minds simply ignore.
Dragon Scales: Grows tough scales that defend against physical harm.

sequences.name: Dreamwalker
abilities: Dream Entry: Enters, watches and reshapes other people's dreams.
Dream Travel: Moves between nearby sleepers' dreams and hides inside them.
Dream Influence: Slowly shifts a dreamer's feelings, loyalties, fears or habits.
Secret Digging: Guides dream imagery to reveal what a dreamer is hiding.

sequences.name: Manipulator
abilities: Subconscious Sea: Enters the sea of collective subconscious to invade minds and read deep thoughts.
Hidden Commands: Buries ideas and orders in minds, leaving almost no trace.
Mind Plague: Spreads mental illness through a whole community.
Mind Storm: Batters mental defenses with hostile, corrupting thoughts.
Virtual Personas: Splits off separate personas that guard its mind or infiltrate others.
Mind Dragon Form: Becomes a demigod with an incomplete Mind Dragon mythical form.

sequences.name: Dream Weaver
abilities: Lifelike Dreams: Weaves dreams so real that fear or wounds inside them can break or kill.
Plague Storm: Spreads desire, unstable emotion and corruption across an area.
Consciousness Stroll: Carries its physical body through the collective subconscious to travel.
Living Personas: Its virtual personas become independent beings that act and grow on their own.

sequences.name: Discerner
abilities: Dream Maze: Links minds through the collective subconscious into a maze that drags victims through their secrets and fears.
Discernment: Sees weaknesses, hidden fears, motives and causes, even past ordinary anti-divination.
Envisioned Form: Temporarily takes on a form or state it truly understands and believes in.
Angelic Form: Completes the Mind Dragon form and becomes an angel.

sequences.name: Author
abilities: Narrative Writing: Writes stories that come true when their events unfold logically.
Arranged Coincidence: Sets up chance meetings and coincidences that steer events.
Name Sense: Notices when its name or title is spoken, and can draw those who know it into its stories.
Living Concepts: Blends dreams with reality and creates mental concepts that act on their own.

sequences.name: Visionary
abilities: Envisioning: Whatever it truly imagines can become real, from beings and objects to a divine kingdom.
Ruler of Minds: Creates or erases personality, memory, emotion and sanity.
Declared Future: Speaks a future that unfolds when backed by enough coherent development.
Loss of Control: Can shatter another Beyonder's mental balance.

pathways.name: Bard
pathways.group: Visionary / Sun / Tyrant / White Tower / Hanged Man

sequences.name: Bard
abilities: Inspiring Song: Sings hymns that boost allies' courage, strength and recovery.
Fearless: Resists fear and helps drive it out of others.
Hardy Body: Gains a healthier, sturdier body.

sequences.name: Light Suppliant
abilities: Sunshine: Calls down scorching sunlight that burns undead and spirits and dazzles foes.
Daytime: Floods an area with light as if it were noon.
Blessing: Shields allies against fear, cold, darkness and deathly influence.
Sun Eyes: Sees in the dark and senses undead and evil beings nearby.
Holy Water: Prepares holy water and performs rituals that call stronger light.

sequences.name: Solar High Priest
abilities: Holy Light Summoning: Calls down a column of purifying light on evil.
Fire of Light: Conjures dense golden flames that burn away corruption.
Cleave of Purification: Blesses weapons and bullets with purifying force.
Sun Halo: Radiates a halo that steadies courage and cleanses evil influence.
Holy Oath: Swears an oath that boosts its body and holy damage.
Horror Immunity: Shrugs off supernatural fear.

sequences.name: Notary
abilities: Amplification: Notarizes a power or effect as valid, making it stronger.
Nullification: Declares an effect invalid, weakening or dispersing it.
Authentication: Judges whether a statement, identity, formula or contract is genuine.
Binding Contract: Witnesses agreements so that breaking them brings holy punishment.

sequences.name: Priest of Light
abilities: Light of Holiness: Calls down a blazing pillar of light that can vaporize targets.
Purification Halo: Fills an area with golden radiance that strengthens allies and destroys impure creatures.
Bane of the Unclean: Its light and flame hit undead and corrupted beings especially hard.

sequences.name: Unshadowed
abilities: Sunbird Body: Becomes a demigod with an incomplete Sunbird form, far stronger, faster and tougher.
Unshadowed Domain: Fills an area with blazing light that reveals hidden things and suppresses darkness.
Direct Purification: Removes corruption, parasites, illness and mental influence, and in time can cleanse Beyonder characteristics.
Unshadowed Spear: Hurls a spear of concentrated holy light.
Flaring Sun: Ignites a fierce miniature sun of searing light.
Holy Armor: Wraps itself in protective armor and weapons of light.

sequences.name: Justice Mentor
abilities: Personal Justice: Turns its own standard of justice into an order binding it, the divine and the world.
Justice Halo: Covers a vast region, empowering acts that fit its justice and weakening those that break it.
Judgment of Justice: Focuses that suppression onto a single target.
Holy Contract: Forms sacred contracts strong enough to restrain angels.
Distant Armor: Extends protective holy armor to allies far away.

sequences.name: Lightseeker
abilities: Miniature Sun: Becomes a small sun, pouring out immense heat, light and purification.
Light Body: Turns into massless light to move at light speed, scatter to avoid harm and reform.
Praise the Sun: Produces absolute purification while strengthening itself.
Spear of Light: Seals the surrounding space so enemies cannot escape.
Justice Trial: Brutally punishes anyone who violates its core justice.

sequences.name: White Angel
abilities: Holy Kingdom: Creates a vast radiant domain where darkness, undead and corruption can barely exist.
Pure White Light: Purifies by breaking down anything out of harmony with its holiness.
Order and Faith: Draws strength from social order and turns people's awe into faith.
Regional Sun: Shines as the sun of a whole region, inspiring and reinforcing followers.

sequences.name: Sun
abilities: Sun Incarnate: Can act, see and strike wherever light shines.
Eternal Day: Brings endless daylight that exposes concealment and suppresses death and darkness.
Divine Contracts: Binds even gods with contracts they cannot easily resist.
Inextinguishable Light: Extremely hard to destroy, able to return after seeming annihilation.

pathways.name: Sailor
pathways.group: Visionary / Sun / Tyrant / White Tower / Hanged Man

sequences.name: Sailor
abilities: Sea Strength: Gains great strength and balance, staying steady on rolling decks and rigging.
Swimmer: Holds breath for a long time, swims fast and resists water pressure.
Slippery Scales: Grows faint illusory scales that make the body slick and hard to grab.

sequences.name: Folk of Rage
abilities: Rage Surge: Anger fuels big boosts to strength, speed and toughness.
Raging Blow: Releases built-up fury in one devastating strike.
Drunken Fury: Drinking speeds up the build-up of rage, at the cost of judgment.

sequences.name: Seafarer
abilities: Navigation: Masters stars, currents, winds and charts, so ships it guides rarely get lost.
Weather Sense: Senses coming storms and changes in the sea.
Water Spells: Uses water to smother foes, raise waves, wash away filth or mend small wounds.
Home Waters: Its water powers grow much stronger while at sea.

sequences.name: Wind-blessed
abilities: Wind Control: Commands gusts, pressure waves and binding winds.
Windblades: Fires invisible blades of cutting wind.
Wind Flight: Hovers, glides and briefly flies, and cushions falls with air.
Wind Whispers: Eavesdrops on distant voices carried by moving air.
Deep Diver: Dives deep, floats with ease and sees in the dark.

sequences.name: Ocean Songster
abilities: Siren Song: Sings to strike the spirit, dazing listeners or stirring awe, rage or grief.
Lightning Strike: Calls down lightning that paralyzes, burns and purifies, and runs through metal and water.
Sea Dweller: Breathes underwater, endures deep pressure and talks with sea creatures.

sequences.name: Cataclysmic Interrer
abilities: Calamity Weather: Raises hurricanes, tsunamis, floods, blizzards and earthquakes.
True Flight: Flies freely on the wind.
Chain Lightning: Unleashes thunder strikes and lightning that leaps between foes.
Storm Veil: Its storms blind sight, senses and divination.
Thunderous Roar: Lets out a roar strong enough to capsize ships.
Demigod Form: Gains an incomplete mythical form whose scales serve as armor.

sequences.name: Sea King
abilities: Sea Authority: Rules a sea region, raising sea levels and huge tsunamis.
Command Sea Life: Commands marine creatures and can turn into sea beasts.
Ocean Rejection: Makes the sea itself reject chosen enemies.
Rain Sight: Sees and senses through rain, clouds and droplets.
Lightning Forest: Raises a forest of lightning bolts.

sequences.name: Calamity
abilities: Disaster Authority: Summons disasters able to wipe out ports, islands or cities.
Storm Body: Manifests through vast weather systems.
Magnetic Storm: Twists magnetic fields to cut off communications.
Source of Wrath: Boosts its power for a while at the cost of reason.
Dread Voice: Spreads terror, grief and submission over huge distances.

sequences.name: Thunder God
abilities: Lightning Body: Becomes pure energy to move and strike at near light speed.
Heavenly Punishment: Calls down lightning that disintegrates and purifies.
Storm Hell: Creates lasting storms over cities, islands or seas.
Sea of Lightning: Fills a whole area with a sea of lightning.
Wrath Surge: Rage briefly lifts its force close to a true god's.

sequences.name: Tyrant
abilities: Matter and Energy: Converts matter to energy and back, driving attacks of world-ending scale.
Divine Lightning: Strikes with lightning that tears through concealment, darkness, spirits and escape.
Tyrant's Presence: Its presence forces fear, awe and submission.
Lord of Storms: Oceans, skies, storms and electromagnetic fields carry its will.

pathways.name: Reader
pathways.group: Visionary / Sun / Tyrant / White Tower / Hanged Man
pathways.speedNote: Relies on copied or prepared abilities more than raw speed.

sequences.name: Reader
abilities: Speed Reading: Gets through books and documents at great speed and remembers nearly everything read.
Rapid Learning: Picks up new subjects, languages and skills far faster than ordinary people.
Clear Focus: Concentrates and understands with unusual clarity, turning heavy reading into usable knowledge.
Ritual Spirituality: Gains enough spirituality to perform basic ritualistic magic.

sequences.name: Student of Ratiocination
abilities: Ratiocination: Builds sound chains of logical deduction from small clues to reach conclusions.
Keen Observation: Notices overlooked details, inconsistencies and contradictions in scenes, accounts and behaviour.
Ordered Memory: Sorts stored knowledge so the right facts surface quickly while reasoning.

sequences.name: Detective
abilities: Clue Hunting: Finds hidden traces and evidence that others walk straight past.
Seeing Through Lies: Spots lies, disguises and false stories from small tells and contradictions.
Scene Reconstruction: Pieces together past events at a location from lingering traces, unless those were erased or falsified.
Field Training: Gains better agility, weapon skill and command of ritual magic for dangerous cases.

sequences.name: Polymath
abilities: Broad Mastery: Rapidly masters many mundane skills and wide fields of mystical knowledge.
Analysis: Studies a Beyonder power it witnesses to work out its pathway, principles, strengths and weaknesses.
Imitation: Recreates a weaker version of a correctly analyzed Beyonder power; a flawed analysis can backfire.

sequences.name: Mysticism Magister
abilities: Ritual Mastery: Performs rituals and applies mystical knowledge freely, reliably and with little preparation.
Mystic Arts: Casts a broad range of spells for attack, defense, healing, sealing and investigation.
Spell Invention: Designs new spells from symbolism, materials and careful experimentation.
Stronger Imitation: Copied Beyonder powers become noticeably stronger, though still weaker than the originals.

sequences.name: Prophet
abilities: Prophecy: Glimpses the futures most likely to happen, though what it shows is probability rather than fixed fate.
Demigod Body: Gains a demigod's physique and spirituality along with an incomplete mythical creature form.
Deeper Analysis: Analyzes and imitates Beyonder powers more thoroughly and accurately than before.

sequences.name: Cognizer
abilities: Cognition: Perceives the true essence, structure, symbols and hidden workings of a target or Beyonder power.
Faithful Imitation: Reproduces the Beyonder powers it has come to understand far more closely than before.
Principle Leverage: Finds the single point where a thing's underlying principles can be exploited with minimal force.
Symbol Spells: Derives a working spell after grasping the meaning of a mystical symbol.

sequences.name: Wisdom Angel
abilities: Wisdom: When forced to choose, foresees how events will shift and picks the most correct action at the right moment.
Angelic Form: Becomes an angel with the complete White Tower mythical creature form.
Heightened Insight: Learning, analysis and prophecy sharpen until the weaknesses of foes and plans lie bare.
Near-Perfect Imitation: Imitated powers come close to the original's full strength, though authorities stay out of reach.

sequences.name: Omniscient Eye
abilities: Omniscient Eye: Watches distant targets, learning their past, present state, likely futures, secrets and weaknesses.
Equal Imitation: Imitated powers match the original's strength, though not its authority or symbolism.
Astral Tampering: Briefly alters one aspect of a concept in the astral world so an action fails, errs or intensifies.

sequences.name: White Tower
abilities: Authority of Knowledge: Holds divine authority over knowledge, wisdom and analysis.
Omniscience: Perceives knowledge about almost anything directly, without needing to consult the spirit world.
Divine Imitation: Imitates any power it understands at full strength and can refine or surpass it.
Principle Mastery: Exploits the foundations of reality and crafts spells that others can cast.

pathways.name: Secrets Supplicant
pathways.group: Visionary / Sun / Tyrant / White Tower / Hanged Man

sequences.name: Secrets Supplicant
abilities: Secret Prayer: Prays to hidden beings for knowledge, rituals or aid, accepting great risk in return.
Steady Mind: Resists the madness and corruption that come with forbidden knowledge.
Hidden Lore: Instinctively knows about sacrifices, secret entities and the dangerous honorific names that reach them.
Spiritual Sense: Senses nearby supernatural auras and can perform rituals and simple divination.

sequences.name: Listener
abilities: Listening: Hears the whispers of hidden existences, picking up strange knowledge, rituals and prophecies.
Whispered Gifts: Sometimes draws fragments of forbidden power or warnings of danger from what it hears, at risk of corruption.

sequences.name: Shadow Ascetic
abilities: Shadow Walking: Merges into shadows to hide, and travels or trails targets through them.
Shadow Shaping: Moulds shadows into weapons, beasts or black cocoons that bind victims.
Shadow Seizure: Grabs hold of a person's shadow to restrain or harm them.
Shadow Curses: Lays curses using blood, flesh or torn fragments of a target's shadow.

sequences.name: Rose Bishop
abilities: Flesh Manipulation: Controls flesh and blood, both its own and other people's.
Regeneration: Commands its own cells to regrow lost limbs and survive wounds to the heart or head.
Flowing Flesh: Melts into a fluid mass of flesh to slip away or hide inside other bodies.
Flesh Constructs: Crafts servants, cloaks and bombs out of living tissue.
Blood Curses: Curses a target through its blood or tissue, or devours it from within.

sequences.name: Shepherd
abilities: Grazing: Devours the souls of the dead or slain and keeps them, using the powers those souls held in life.
Soul Flock: Keeps several grazed souls at once and switches between their powers while keeping its own.

sequences.name: Black Knight
abilities: Black Armor: Encases itself in black armor and swells into a small giant.
Shadow Command: Commands the shadows of a battlefield and binds foes through their own shadows.
Black Greatsword: Wields a dark greatsword that corrodes flesh, wounds souls and cleaves through barriers.
Thought Peeling: Strips depraved thoughts or invading personalities out of a mind, casting them off as shadows.
Betrayal: Makes objects and powers turn against the very people using them.

sequences.name: Trinity Templar
abilities: Trinity: Splits personality, body and power into three coordinated aspects.
Three Heads: Grows two shadowy heads, one young and one old, each able to regrow into a full being.
Single-Cell Revival: Rebuilds from one surviving cell as long as its spirit endures and flesh is available.
Shadow Substitute: Lets its shadow take damage in place of its body.
Triple Release: Releases up to three grazed souls at the same time.

sequences.name: Profane Presbyter
abilities: Profane Language: Twists the meaning of words and gestures into curses that imprison, separate, corrupt or erase identity.
Malice Shackles: Turns a target's own malice, envy or cowardice into chains that bind it.
Self-Reference: Draws strength whenever others refer to it.
Many-Headed Grazing: Uses the powers of several grazed souls simultaneously.

sequences.name: Dark Angel
abilities: Shadow Dominion: Rules much of the shadow world and stands firm against purifying light.
Degeneration: Makes bodies, items, powers and servants betray and turn on their owners.
Sea of Darkness: Summons an ocean of darkness that swallows attacks and dulls thought.
Profane Speech: Its words drain life and drive listeners deeper into madness.
Depraved Servants: Releases grazed souls as servants that keep their powers but obey through corruption.

sequences.name: Hanged Man
abilities: Authority of Sacrifice: Bears others' wounds, death or punishment, or sacrifices itself to secure a desired outcome.
Authority of Degeneration: Awakens depravity in the living and corrupts bodies, powers, objects and even principles.
Lord of Shadows: Rules the shadow world and spawns monsters from darkness that return after death.
Divine Grazing: Absorbs souls, Beyonder characteristics and even higher symbols.

sequences.name: Sleepless
abilities: Little Sleep: Stays fully alert on only a few hours of sleep.
Night Empowerment: Grows stronger, faster and sharper as the night deepens.
Dark Vision: Sees clearly in darkness.
Spirit Sense: Has high spirituality, a sense for danger, and can perform simple rituals and divination.

sequences.name: Midnight Poet
abilities: Midnight Poems: Recites poems or songs that calm, frighten, pacify or soothe listeners.
Lulling Verse: Uses chanted verse to wear down resistance and send groups of people to sleep.
Night Fighter: Gains better combat training and a stronger boost from the night.

sequences.name: Nightmare
abilities: Dream Entry: Enters, observes and reshapes the dreams of sleepers nearby.
Nightmare: Pulls targets into sleep-like dreams and attacks their minds with terrifying visions.
Dream Interrogation: Draws memories and truths out of a dreamer by steering the dream.

sequences.name: Soul Assurer
abilities: Requiem: Lulls a spirit into deep stillness, suppressing thought, emotion, intuition and movement.
Soul Soothing: Calms and protects the souls of companions against mental strain and attack.
Spirit Pacifying: Quiets ghosts and silences restless undead.
Spirit Perception: Directly perceives spiritual beings, with stronger ritual and divination skill.

sequences.name: Spirit Warlock
abilities: Spirit Command: Commands spirits as obedient servants.
Spirit Sealing: Seals natural, evil or dead spirits inside its body, keeping them dormant until needed.
Spirit Summoning: Calls sealed spirits out to fight, scout, track, fly or shield it.

sequences.name: Nightwatcher
abilities: Domain of Night: Spreads pure darkness that empowers it and its spirits while weakening and draining enemies.
Concealment: Hides its appearance, identity and mystical connections from sight and divination.
Curse of Misfortune: Sours a target's luck so accidents and failures follow it.
Demigod Form: Gains a demigod's body and an incomplete mythical creature form.

sequences.name: Horror Bishop
abilities: Horror: Radiates an aura of terror that can paralyze, unhinge or even kill weaker beings.
Nightmare World: Drags everyone across a small city into a shared dream that it controls.
Sword of Darkness: Forms a blade of darkness whose silent waves dissolve whatever they touch.

sequences.name: Servant of Concealment
abilities: Concealment Authority: Hides people, places, actions and truths, even from divination and prophecy.
Unveiling: Strips away concealment that others have cast.
Concealed World: Creates a hidden realm where battles leave the outside untouched and secrets cannot be spoken.
Angelic Form: Becomes an angel with a complete mythical creature form.

sequences.name: Knight of Misfortune
abilities: Misfortune Authority: Brings bad luck, accidents and disasters on individuals, nations or whole continents.
Return from Darkness: Revives after death through the darkness, though each return risks merging with it.
Spirit Legions: Commands vast numbers of spirits at once.

sequences.name: Darkness
abilities: Authority of Night: Rules night, darkness and sleep, granting dreams, repose or eternal slumber.
Divine Concealment: Erases traces, identities and connections, or hides entire realms from the world.
Misfortune and Horror: Spreads catastrophe and terror on a divine scale.
Eternal Night: Cannot be permanently killed while darkness remains.
Lord of Spirits: Commands the spirits of nature.

sequences.name: Corpse Collector
abilities: Corpse Immunity: Shrugs off corpse poison, rot and the deathly aura of cadavers.
Undead Insight: Spots the weak points of undead creatures.
Cold Resistance: Barely feels cold and runs at a low body temperature.
Spirit Vision: Sees ghosts and spirits, many of which treat it as harmless.
Corpse Lore: Skilled at examining bodies and telling unnatural deaths from natural ones.

sequences.name: Gravedigger
abilities: Burial Rites: Knows the funeral rites that lay the dead to rest and keep them from rising.
Undead Fighter: Gains greater strength, agility and techniques for fighting the undead.
Spirit Talk: Speaks with nearby spirits and gives them simple orders, such as holding a target.
Eye of Death: Finds the vital spiritual nodes of unfamiliar undead and monsters with no normal anatomy.

sequences.name: Spirit Medium
abilities: Spirit Communication: Sees and speaks with the spirits of the dead and of nature.
Spirit Channeling: Borrows nearby spirits to learn information or to chill, bind and track targets.
Soul Channeling: Contacts recently departed souls, or with more risk, the spirit of a living person.
Deathly State: Mimics an undead's spiritual state to resist cold, decay and death energy.

sequences.name: Spirit Guide
abilities: Language of the Dead: Speaks words that act directly on spirits, drawing souls from bodies or controlling them.
Spirit Command: Guides and commands spirits and ownerless undead in large numbers.
Raise Dead: Animates corpses as mindless zombies and skeletons.

sequences.name: Gatekeeper
abilities: Underworld Gate: Senses and opens doors to the underworld that suck targets in.
Grasp of the Dead: Its gates release undead hands that seize enemies and drag them into the realm of the dead.
Inner Underworld: Stores many souls, spirits and undead inside its body as a hidden army.

sequences.name: Undying
abilities: Undying Body: Survives fatal wounds; only complete destruction of the body truly threatens it.
Half-Dead Existence: Exists between body and spirit and can travel through the spirit world.
Withering Wind: Unleashes a deathly wind that withers living things.
Death Spells: Casts death magic and can seal dangerous objects.
Demigod Form: Gains a demigod's power and an incomplete mythical creature form.

sequences.name: Ferryman
abilities: Soul Ferrying: Carries souls across the river of the dead to their final end.
Death Gaze: A look that kills ordinary beings and withers stronger ones.
Hands of Life and Death: Its left hand pulls targets toward death while its right can return life.
Already Dead: Shrugs off most attacks other than purification, since the dead cannot die again.

sequences.name: Death Consul
abilities: Angelic Form: Becomes an angel with a complete mythical creature form.
Nation of the Dead: Creates a city-sized domain where weak life dies instantly and stronger beings slowly wither.
Absolute Death: Drains vitality from an area and blocks most resurrection and substitution tricks.
Judge of the Dead: Judges and enslaves the dead, commanding vast undead armies.

sequences.name: Pale Emperor
abilities: Pale World: Drains all color from an area, rapidly weathering objects and weakening color-based powers.
Death Decree: Sentences anyone it sees or points at to death.
Soul Enslavement: Pulls out Spirit Bodies and enslaves any living being that has a soul.
Soul Suppression: Crushes souls, snuffing out thought and vitality.

sequences.name: Death
abilities: Authority of Death: Rules death and the underworld, the final destination of all life.
Conceptual Death: Kills not only life but memories, connections, substitutes and paths of resurrection.
Master of Undead: Source and lord of all undead, able to enslave anything with a soul.
Pallor: Silences mind, will, color and supernatural power.

sequences.name: Warrior
abilities: Peak Physique: Gains strength, agility and endurance far beyond ordinary people.
Combat Reflexes: Reacts in battle with sharp instincts and quickly learns unfamiliar fighting styles.
Weapon Handling: Uses almost any ordinary weapon or armor effectively from the start.

sequences.name: Pugilist
abilities: Unarmed Mastery: Masters punching, kicking, grappling and every kind of bare-handed fighting.
Greater Strength: Grows strong enough to wrestle larger foes and break restraints while keeping balance.
Iron Vitality: Partly resists supernatural effects through sheer vitality and willpower.

sequences.name: Weapon Master
abilities: Weapon Mastery: Expertly wields anything used as a weapon, from unfamiliar firearms to mystical items.
Weak Point Sense: Senses where an enemy is most vulnerable.
Artifact Handling: Lessens the harmful side effects of weapon-shaped sealed artifacts it wields.
Improvised Arms: Turns ordinary objects into deadly weapons through understanding of weight, reach and timing.

sequences.name: Dawn Paladin
abilities: Dawn Armor: Clads itself in weightless silver armor of dawn light that mends by burning stamina.
Sword of Dawn: Condenses holy dawn light into purifying weapons.
Hurricane of Light: Shatters a dawn weapon into a storm of radiant blades, deadly to undead, spirits and shadows.
Light of Dawn: Sheds sacred light that dispels illusions and weakens shadows, wraiths and corruption.

sequences.name: Guardian
abilities: Protection: Plants a weapon to raise an invisible, nearly unbreakable barrier around allies.
Shield Bearer: Takes damage meant for the allies it is protecting.
Fortress Body: Has such durability that ordinary firearms barely trouble it.
Steadfast Mind: Strongly resists illusions and mind control.

sequences.name: Demon Hunter
abilities: Insight: Instinctively reads a target's true nature, weaknesses, corruption or possession.
Demon Hunting Lore: Knows monsters deeply and crafts oils, potions and ointments that counter them.
Hidden Intent: Conceals its intentions and actions from danger sense, divination and prophecy.
Demigod Body: Gains demigod strength and an incomplete giant form.

sequences.name: Silver Knight
abilities: Silver Giant: Becomes a huge giant clad in silver armor it can sustain indefinitely.
Mercury Body: Turns into liquid silver to dodge attacks, bind or smother enemies, or armor an ally.
Silver Rapier: Launches nearly invisible blades of light that appear beside or inside targets.
Light Travel: Hides inside and moves through sources of light.

sequences.name: Glory
abilities: Twilight Decay: Its blows age and rot targets, stripping away lifespan.
Angelic Form: Becomes an angel with a complete giant form and authority over twilight and combat.
Cage: Raises a vast barrier that shields, restrains and seals while wearing foes down with decay.
Twilight Sword: Thrusts a blade through space to strike a distant target.

sequences.name: Hand of God
abilities: Proxy: Acts as the hand of a deity or great being, wielding part of that patron's power.
Lent Marks: Condenses its strength into marks it can lend to others.
Great Cage: Raises enormous protective barriers that hold even under angelic assault.

sequences.name: Twilight Giant
abilities: Authority of Twilight: Ages, corrodes and collapses matter, will, mystical effects and even time.
Land of Twilight: Rules a divine kingdom frozen near the end of all things that weakens intruders.
God of Combat: Has unmatched strength, size and fighting skill, and can strip foes of their learned skills.
Dawn and Holiness: Purifies corruption with dawn light and holy power.

sequences.name: Hunter
abilities: Hunter's Craft: Masters wilderness survival, tracking prey, building and placing traps, and handling explosives.
Heightened Senses: Sharper sight, hearing and smell let the Hunter follow faint trails and spot hidden prey.
Physical Enhancement: Gains greater strength, speed, reflexes and body control, plus faster natural healing.
Danger Intuition: Passively senses hostility and threats aimed at them before they strike.

sequences.name: Provoker
abilities: Provocation: Taunts a target with cutting words until they lose composure, act rashly and fixate on the Provoker.
Trigger Reading: Quickly spots the sore points, pride and habits that will most easily enrage a given person.
Physical Enhancement: Strength, reflexes, speed and agility improve another step.

sequences.name: Pyromaniac
abilities: Pyrokinesis: Conjures and shapes fire at will, from compressed fireballs to flame bombs that detonate on a delay.
Blazing Spear: Hurls a white-hot spear of flame that pins its target in place and burns it.
Fire Ravens: Releases a flock of burning ravens that lock onto several targets and explode on contact.
Wall of Fire: Raises a barrier of writhing flame serpents that blocks and scorches anything trying to pass.
Flame Armor: Wraps the body in protective fire and sets weapons or projectiles ablaze, harming even spirits.
Fire Resistance: Barely hurt by flames, though the force of explosions can still injure.

sequences.name: Conspirer
abilities: Conspiracy: Uses misdirection, confusion and deception to steer situations and opponents into prepared traps.
Schemer's Insight: Thinks faster and more clearly, reading people and situations to find openings for a plot.
Incitement: Plants chosen thoughts or desires in others through seemingly casual conversation.
Flame Jump: Merges into a flame or fire spell and reappears wherever that fire is, starting at about ten meters.
Crimson Flames: Fire burns hotter and can be shaped into whips and sabers solid enough to parry.

sequences.name: Reaper
abilities: Weakness Investigation: Detects a target's vulnerable points, even in barriers and non-physical bodies.
Cull: Charges attacks with a life-reaping force that can kill outright when it lands on a weak point.
Precision: Guides fireballs, fire ravens and other flames exactly, splitting them to strike several targets at once.

sequences.name: Iron-blooded Knight
abilities: Galvanization: Turns the body, and even its flames, into steel at will for tremendous toughness.
Chain of Command: Forms a hidden link with subordinates to speak silently, pool their strength and ease their burdens.
Mind of Steel: Becomes highly resistant to fear and mental attacks without losing sound judgment.
Weapon Augmentation: Makes ordinary objects into deadly, durable weapons that can be hurled or wreathed in flame.
Calamity Giant: Can take an incomplete Mythical Creature form, a giant of calamity, at a heavy cost.
Masculine Change: The potion turns a female drinker into a man.

sequences.name: War Bishop
abilities: War Song: A battle cry that raises allies' morale, strength and stamina while weakening nearby foes.
Fog of War: Clouds senses and mystical links within an area, making most curses and divination fail.
Ritualist of War: Once per battle, offers sacrifices to ask the essence of war for aid, such as swapping positions.
Army Unleashed: Command over troops deepens, letting soldiers move as one and fight at their full strength.
Prayer Response: Hears and answers prayers within range, growing stronger the more soldiers anchor it.

sequences.name: Weather Warlock
abilities: Weather Manipulation: Calls up or calms storms, blizzards, lightning and rain over a vast area, even triggering quakes or tsunamis.
Wind Flight: Rides the wind to fly and hover freely.
Charisma: Naturally inspires loyalty and admiration without needing to charm anyone.
Meteor Flames: Rains violet-blue fire down like a meteor shower across tens of kilometers.
Calamity Giant Form: Becomes a complete giant of calamity that sets onlookers ablaze and brings storms with it.

sequences.name: Conqueror
abilities: Conquest: Radiates overwhelming supremacy that subjugates people, objects and even terrain into its soldiers.
Conqueror's Armor: The steel form becomes iron-black, blood-stained armor rivaling the toughest Angels.
Shared Rank: Soldiers under its command can borrow its rank, powers and spirituality, at a steep cost.

sequences.name: Red Priest
abilities: Authority of War: Embodies war and the hunt, spreading conflict and destructive urges and ruling every soldier who fights.
Destruction: Destroys physical and even conceptual things, able to collapse space-time with a clenched fist.
Divine Conquest: Conquers anything, even abstract ideas, and forms a divine kingdom from conquered land.
Masculinity: Holds authority over male forces and can turn beings or objects male.

sequences.name: Assassin
abilities: Shadow Concealment: Melts into darkness and shadow to stay hidden, though sprinting breaks the cover.
Light Feet: Gains agile limbs, silent footwork and speed suited to stealth and evasion.
Feather Fall: Makes the body extremely light to drop safely from great heights or glide.
Mighty Blow: Gathers all the body's strength into a single devastating strike.
Heightened Senses: Sharper hearing and vision, including the ability to see in the dark.

sequences.name: Instigator
abilities: Instigation: Plants thoughts in people's minds, nudging them toward quarrels, betrayals or other chosen actions.
Emotion Sensing: Reads the emotions and desires stirring in others to find levers for manipulation.
Physical Enhancement: The body grows somewhat stronger, though combat skill barely improves.

sequences.name: Witch
abilities: Witch's Change: The potion turns a male drinker into a woman and greatly heightens beauty and charm.
Black Flame: Conjures black fire that burns spirituality, striking spirit bodies and burning even underwater.
Frost: Commands ice to seal locks, slick floors, freeze foes and send out chilling winds.
Mirror Substitution: Uses a mirror to make a stand-in that takes fatal harm in the Witch's place.
Curse: Harms a target from afar through a medium such as their blood, hair or a doll.
Witchcraft: Turns invisible with powder and incantation, hides briefly inside mirrors and excels at mirror divination.

sequences.name: Pleasure
abilities: Silk Threads: Spins near-invisible threads from hair to bind enemies, sense movement and weave cocoons.
Pleasure: Floods victims with overwhelming pleasure through threads or touch, leaving them helpless.
Addictive Charm: Allure becomes intoxicating, leaving victims craving the Demoness and easy to control.
Reflection Curse: Curses a target through their full-body reflection in a mirror.

sequences.name: Affliction
abilities: Disease: Releases airborne pathogens that infect people nearby and make them fall ill with unnatural speed.
Mirror Curses: Traps foes in mirror illusions and burns any body part a mirror reflects.
Active Charm: Charms someone deliberately with a single glance, gesture or word.
Hair Weapon: Hair hardens into piercing strands that can inject Black Flames into a victim.
Living Threads: Threads become extensions of the body, precise enough to handle small objects.

sequences.name: Despair
abilities: Plague: Spreads deadly, specialized plagues up to three kilometers away, filling whole districts with sickness and despair.
Petrification: Hair or threads that touch someone stiffen that body part and turn it to stone.
Overwhelming Charm: Makes even mid-Sequence Beyonders fall in love and grow addicted within moments.
Mirror Maze: Builds mirror mazes, projects itself through mirrors across a city and locates mirrors kilometers away.
Gorgon Form: Can take an incomplete Gorgon form whose sight fills onlookers with pleasure and pain.

sequences.name: Unaging
abilities: Mirror Self: Merges with a mirror double, freezing their age and making true death almost impossible.
Concealed Resurrection: Hides a shielded mirror double to revive in if the main body is destroyed.
Spreading Stone: Anything touching infected flesh or spider silk begins turning to stone.
Mind-Halting Charm: Charm can freeze a target's thoughts and, given time, make even Angels fall in love.
Mirror World Travel: Moves through the Mirror World via eyes and reflections, controlling mirrors across a city.
Gorgon Form: Takes a complete Gorgon form with serpent hair that petrifies whatever it looks at.

sequences.name: Catastrophe
abilities: Catastrophe: Triggers collapse in people, places and systems, from natural disasters to the breakdown of Beyonder powers.
Feared Name: Anyone who speaks the Demoness's name is gripped by deep fear.
Curse of Destiny: Cursed objects or words bring a chain of misfortunes to anyone who touches or hears them.
Devouring Plague: Pathogens grow strong enough to eat away even complete Mythical Creatures.
Many Mirror Selves: Can split off several mirror doubles at once, starting with five.

sequences.name: Apocalypse
abilities: Apocalypse: Drives a person, place or system into total contradiction and collapse, even ending a target's destiny.
Doomsday Calamities: Unleashes disasters on a scale able to devastate whole regions.

sequences.name: Primordial Demoness
abilities: Chaos and Ruin: Returns things to primordial disorder, dissolving targets into swirling, unrealized possibilities.
Universal Charm: Charms everything, even abstract concepts, until rules turn against themselves.
Mirror Dominion: Controls the entire Mirror World and can appear anywhere within it.
Femininity: Holds authority over female forces and can turn beings or objects female.
Primordial Plague: Creates countless unseen pathogens that, given time, can infect even True Gods.

sequences.name: Planter
abilities: Farming Mastery: Expertly tends seeds, crops and soil and handles farm tools to bring in healthy harvests.
Physical Enhancement: Gains greatly increased strength and stamina.
Weather Reading: Predicts coming weather by reading clouds, wind and other natural signs.

sequences.name: Doctor
abilities: Healing: Treats injuries and illnesses of both body and soul, including ailments caused by evil or corruption.
Surgical Mastery: Performs skilled surgery, from suturing severed limbs to transplanting organs.
Soul Suture: Operates directly on the soul to mend wounds, remove curses and corruption, or attack it.
Diagnostic Vision: Reads a patient's health precisely, spotting hidden illness from outward signs.
Giving Life: Gradually restores strength and vigor to the weak and exhausted.

sequences.name: Harvest Priest
abilities: Seed Catalysis: Speeds the growth of seeds and plants, even raising thorny vines to entangle enemies.
Plant and Insect Command: Directs mindless plants and insects within about thirty meters to aid the priest.
Weather Rituals: Performs rituals that clear the skies or call down rain for the crops.
Blessing of the Land: Healing now extends to crops, fields and land, curing blights and plant diseases.

sequences.name: Biologist
abilities: Cross-breeding: Creates chimeras and entirely new species by combining animals, plants and even objects.
Poison Creation: The body produces potent toxins that can be released through hair or other means.
Knowledge of Life: Deeply understands the traits and inner workings of living organisms.

sequences.name: Druid
abilities: Wrath of Nature: Turns the surroundings hostile against up to fifty chosen enemies.
Swamp: Turns the ground within thirty meters into a swamp that traps or buries foes.
Underground Travel: Softens the earth to sink into it and travel underground.
Child of the Oak: Covers the body in protective bark or stone skin.
Earth Golems: Builds golems of stone and earth to fight or labor.
Animal Shape: Transforms into a giant bear or similar beast, though without the creature's special powers.

sequences.name: Classical Alchemist
abilities: Artificial Life: Creates golems and long-lived artificial humans from soul fragments and raw materials.
Mutation: Attacks warp a target's body and mind and push them toward madness.
Creature Command: Controls low-intelligence Beyonder creatures and briefly calms their insanity.
Life Aura: Fills the surroundings with life force, making plants, animals and people grow rapidly.
Restoring Touch: Heals anyone by touch and can briefly return reason to those who lost control.
Mythical Form: Can take a partial, incomplete Mythical Creature form, at a cost.

sequences.name: Pallbearer
abilities: Evil Spirit Conversion: Turns the dead within ten kilometers into Evil Spirits that serve the Pallbearer.
Life Deprivation: Every blow puts the target through a trial of death that may kill instantly and otherwise drains life.
Death Descent: Drains the life of targets in range without touching them.
Return to Earth: Dissolves undead within ten kilometers back into the soil.
Maternal Embrace: Seals even undead Angels away within a coffin and the earth.
Clay Golems: Gives life to up to three golems of soil or clay with demigod strength.

sequences.name: Desolate Matriarch
abilities: Fertility and Barrenness: Makes land for hundreds of kilometers burst with life, or turns it barren so crops wither.
Desolation: Drains all life within thirty kilometers and poisons a wider area, pushing Beyonders toward losing control.
Legion of the Dead: Turns every dead human within fifty kilometers into an Evil Spirit, some as strong as demigods.
Great Golems: Builds dolls and golems from soil, plants, lava, ore and metal, up to nine of demigod strength.
Mythical Creature Form: Becomes a complete mythical creature, a mass of flesh, organs, wheat, mushrooms and vines.
Feminine Change: The potion turns a male drinker into a woman.

sequences.name: Naturewalker
abilities: Child of Nature: Reshapes the environment and merges with natural elements to move and fight within them.
Nature's Command: Commands natural forces such as fire, lightning and even the light of the sun and moon.
World Creation: Nurtures a realm of its own that embodies nature itself.
Authority of Nature: Holds partial authority over nature and motherhood, empowering every earlier ability.

sequences.name: Mother
abilities: Motherhood: Gives birth to all things and can awaken life even in the inanimate.
Earth: As the origin and resting place of all things, rules the cycle of life, death and return.
Nature: Has near-indestructible vitality and raises plant barriers able to hold back True Gods.
Life and Death: Makes creatures grow and mutate uncontrollably, or drains the life even of gods.
Bountiful Earth: Rules a fertile divine kingdom, with lesser authority over harvest, healing and desolation.

sequences.name: Apothecary
abilities: Medicine Concoction: Brews herbal remedies and potions that cure most illnesses and injuries, short of terminal ones.
Poison Craft: Prepares poisons from herbs and has modest resistance to poisons and toxins.
Spirit Vision: Sees a person's overall health and well-being at a glance.

sequences.name: Beast Tamer
abilities: Taming: Tames, domesticates and commands animals, even Beyonder creatures.
Animal Sense: Talks with animals, shares their senses and reads their emotions and intentions.

sequences.name: Vampire
abilities: Rapid Regeneration: Becomes a vampire whose wounds close at unnatural speed, making it very hard to kill.
Wings of Darkness: Sprouts shadowy bat wings for swift flight, or bursts them into a swarm of attacking bats.
Blood Drain: Drinks a victim's blood to sap their life and restore its own strength.
Claws of Corrosion: Extends sharp, corrosive nails that cut steel and tear through scales or hide.
Abyss Shackles: Condenses darkness into chains that bind and restrain enemies.
The Embrace: Converts humans into vampires or into obedient blood servants.

sequences.name: Potions Professor
abilities: Specialty Potions: Brews potions with Beyonder effects, such as invisibility, fire breathing, dreamless sleep or shadow cloaking.
Material Discernment: Instantly judges the properties of spiritual ingredients and how to combine them.
Sun Water: Prepares a holy liquid that badly harms undead and vampires.
Cure for the Incurable: Medicines can now treat even terminal illnesses.
Physical Enhancement: Gains greater speed, agility and strength.

sequences.name: Scarlet Scholar
abilities: Lunar Battlefield: Shapes the area with moonlight, conjuring a full-moon field or a moonless dark that favors the Scholar.
Moonlight Flash: Teleports short distances whenever moonlight is present.
Moonlight Body: Turns into condensed moonlight that reforms after shattering unless the heart is struck.

sequences.name: Shaman King
abilities: Instant Rituals: Performs rituals instantly by drawing on nature, including raising corpses as undead servants.
Moon Paper Figurine: Swaps places with a paper figure made of moonlight that takes the hit instead.
Gaze of Darkness: Curses a target through a linked eyeball, restraining or gravely wounding them via the eye.
Bat Swarm Body: Splits into a swarm of bats and reforms unless every single bat is destroyed.

sequences.name: High Summoner
abilities: Door of Summoning: Opens an illusory door to call powerful creatures from the Spirit World and other realms.
Mythical Creature Form: Takes a fuller mythical form and can hear prayers offered within a certain range.

sequences.name: Life-Giver
abilities: Life Creation: Brings entirely new living beings into existence.
Proliferation: Spurs living things around it to multiply and flourish.

sequences.name: Beauty Goddess
abilities: Divine Beauty: Possesses a pure, godlike beauty that inspires admiration and a wish to protect her.
Charm of Beauty: Turns that beauty into a pull on others' spirituality, the source of her strongest powers.
Femininity: Embodies feminine yin energy.

sequences.name: Moon
abilities: Blood Moon: Can raise a blood moon each day, letting negative energy and monsters flood into reality.
Authority of the Moon: Rules the moon, reproduction, fertility and the proliferation of life.
Supreme Beauty: Becomes the most beautiful being in existence.

sequences.name: Criminal
abilities: Criminal Proficiency: Knows a convict's tricks and can kill efficiently with almost any weapon at hand.
Physical Enhancement: Gains a tougher, stronger body built for violence.
Criminal Instincts: Keen instincts warn of danger and sniff out opportunities for crime.

sequences.name: Unwinged Angel
abilities: Demonic Traits: The body changes in inhuman ways, granting two or three minor devil-like spells that vary per person.
Cold Blood: Feels little guilt or empathy, staying calm and ruthless in the face of violence.
Physical Enhancement: Strength and toughness rise further.

sequences.name: Serial Killer
abilities: Devil Worship: Masters the rituals and ritual magic used to worship and please devils.
Devil's Favor: Ritual killings earn a devil's favor that can later summon a devil's projection for aid.
Cold Intellect: Gains sharper intelligence and mental focus for planning crimes.

sequences.name: Devil
abilities: Danger Premonition: Senses imminent threats and where they come from before they strike.
Sulfur Flames: Conjures poisonous flames and exploding sulfur fireballs that burn and poison targets.
Corruption: Unleashes an area attack that afflicts victims with symptoms of the Abyss's corruption.
Devil Spells: Numbs and slows nearby foes, or clots a victim's blood with a potentially lethal spell.
Demonization: Takes a true devil form with armored skin, greater strength and speed, and immunity to most poisons.
Devil Bloodline: Gains racial traits that vary by devil species, such as escaping death by leaving only a shadow behind.

sequences.name: Desire Apostle
abilities: Desire Mastery: Seizes and inflames the emotions and desires of distant targets, driving them toward ruin.
Defiling Seeds: Plants seeds of corruption in an emotionally shaken target that fester into depravity or death.
Avatar of Desire: Turns into an illusory black liquid that is hard to harm or track and sways enemies' emotions.

sequences.name: Demon
abilities: Mind Fog: Slowly dulls the thinking of everyone nearby without them noticing.
Desire Illusions: Twists desires through its actions, causing illusions that shatter sanity or trigger loss of control.
Long Premonition: Danger sense sometimes warns of threats two or three days in advance.
Partial Demonization: Manifests part of its mythical form on one body part for sustained power.
Cunning Mind: Becomes cold, sharp and sly, with a demigod's intellect.

sequences.name: Blatherer
abilities: Blathering: Its words corrupt listeners' minds, causing confusion, injury, curses or loss of control.
Distant Whispers: Its murmurs can reach targets far away and bring about sudden death.
Prayer Response: Can hear and answer prayers within a certain range.

sequences.name: Bloody Archduke
abilities: Blood Form: Becomes corrosive blood that makes opponents bleed from every orifice until they die.
Fear: Wields core authority over fear.
Seed of Malice: Plants an evolved seed of corruption that erodes the mind and can be used to revive or kill.
Desire Awakening: Draws out a target's deepest desires until they show signs of losing control.
Mythical Creature Form: Has fully become a mythical creature of the Abyss.

sequences.name: Filthy Monarch
abilities: Filth: Rules filth and corruption, defiling bodies, minds and places.
Corrosion: Eats away matter, power and will alike.
Pollution: Spreads contamination that taints and degrades everything it touches.

sequences.name: Abyss
abilities: Authority of Depravity: Rules degeneration and desire, dragging beings down into corruption.
Curses and Mutation: Holds authority over curses and twisted mutations.
Fear and Malice: Embodies fear and malice itself.
Malice Incarnate: Becomes a black liquid that slips into bodies, minds and souls as a Seed of Malice, travelling between hosts.

sequences.name: Prisoner
abilities: Self-Restraint: Suppresses urges, hunger, pain and fear, staying composed under temptation or confinement.
Unbending Will: Resists being controlled or manipulated, holding firm against outside influence on the mind.
Physical Enhancement: Gains greater strength, endurance and pain tolerance.

sequences.name: Lunatic
abilities: Frenzy: Lets madness take hold to gain raw strength, speed and pain tolerance at the cost of judgment.
Madman's Intuition: Unhinged thinking sharpens a sense of danger and hostility around them.
Physical Enhancement: The body grows markedly stronger.

sequences.name: Werewolf
abilities: Wolf Transformation: Turns partly or fully into a wolf-like beast with claws, fangs and great strength.
Regeneration: Heals wounds rapidly and shrugs off ordinary injuries.
Predator Senses: Gains a wolf's keen nose and hearing for tracking blood, fear and movement.

sequences.name: Zombie
abilities: Zombie Body: Becomes cold, pale and near-undead, resisting bullets, poison and disease.
Undying Endurance: Feels little pain, barely needs air and survives wounds that would kill the living.
Command Zombies: Raises and controls zombies as servants.
Deathly Chill: Gives off a corpse-like cold that unsettles those nearby.

sequences.name: Wraith
abilities: Incorporeal Form: Becomes a ghostly body that passes through walls and objects, flies and turns invisible.
Possession: Enters and takes over another person's body, using it as its own.
Wraith Scream: Lets out a shriek that strikes the spirit, causing terror, confusion or unconsciousness.
Mirror Travel: Hides in and passes through mirrors and other reflective surfaces.
Ghost Command: Controls lesser ghosts and spirits.

sequences.name: Puppet
abilities: Object Control: Animates and commands inanimate objects within a radius, like a poltergeist.
Puppetry: Turns possessed or captured victims into puppets whose bodies it moves at will.
Puppet Body: Gains a doll-like, resilient body that is very hard to destroy.
Mythical Form: Can take an incomplete Mythical Creature form as a demigod.

sequences.name: Disciple of Silence
abilities: Source of Curses: Curses people through any link to them, such as belongings, blood or a name.
Cursed Artifact: Can become like a living cursed object that afflicts whoever touches or uses it.
Silence: Smothers sound, speech and spellcasting within an area.

sequences.name: Ancient Bane
abilities: Ancient Curses: Lays lasting curses that can spread through bloodlines, groups or whole regions.
Mythical Creature Form: Becomes a complete mythical creature built around an ancient evil relic that anchors its curses.
Corrupting Presence: Its influence warps the bodies and minds of those nearby toward monstrous forms.

sequences.name: Abomination
abilities: Abomination Form: Transforms into a monstrous, ever-shifting abomination of tremendous power.
Mad Curse: Inflicts curses of madness strong enough to afflict even gods.
Mutation: Twists bodies, spirits and surroundings into monstrous shapes.

sequences.name: Chained
abilities: Restraint: Binds and seals bodies, souls and powers, even the freedom of gods.
Transformation: Rules mutation and monstrous change, turning beings into creatures of its pathway.
Curses: Holds authority over curses that bind and torment.
Indulgence: Releases suppressed desires, letting targets mutate according to their deepest urges.

pathways.name: Lawyer
pathways.speedNote: Repositions by exploiting rules and loopholes.

sequences.name: Lawyer
abilities: Eloquence: Argues with persuasive force and sharp logic, quietly steering how listeners judge a case.
Exploit Loopholes: Spots gaps in rules, contracts and procedures, and weak points in an opponent's position, then turns them to advantage.
Subtle Influence: Their reasoning sways people almost unnoticed, slipping past spiritual intuition and even working when they do not intend it.

sequences.name: Barbarian
abilities: Barbarian Body: Strength, toughness and stamina rise far beyond human limits, making them a ferocious close-quarters fighter.
Iron Will: Shrugs off persuasion, intimidation and other mental influence that would sway ordinary people.

sequences.name: Briber
abilities: Bribery: Handing over any real or symbolic payment, even a tossed coin the target refuses, opens a channel for supernatural influence.
Weaken: A bribe saps the target's strength, lowering their attack, defense and resistance.
Charm: A bribe fills the target with goodwill toward the Briber and softens their hostility.
Arrogance: A bribe inflates the target's pride so they underestimate danger and misjudge the fight.
Bond: A bribe ties a mystical thread between Briber and target that later powers can build on.

sequences.name: Baron of Corruption
abilities: Corruption: Stirs greed and dark desires in everyone within about ten meters, pushing them toward reckless, immoral choices.
Distortion: Twists the meaning of words, actions and intentions, so a strike becomes a miss or shutting a door seals a room.
Redirection: Bends an attack's path or a supernatural effect's target toward a harmless or favorable result.
Corrupt Strength: Physical power surges again, with blows that hit like cannon shells.

sequences.name: Mentor of Disorder
abilities: Disorder: Throws a target or area into chaos, so rules fail, attacks miss, distances mislead and foes choose badly.
Imperious Presence: Radiates a majesty that makes weaker people want to bow and carry out their orders.
Shared Harm: Distortion now spreads curses, illnesses and injuries along mystical links, forcing connected targets to share the damage.
Slip Free: Combines disorder and distortion to escape another's control or a losing position.

sequences.name: Earl of the Fallen
abilities: Exploit: Stretches or cuts short an existing state, such as prolonging a jump into flight or keeping an opening from closing.
Magnify: Hugely amplifies one action, wound or effect, turning a scratch fatal or a gust into a gale.
Bestowment: Curses a target with money obsession, greedy impatience, lost fighting spirit or sluggish limpness.
Rule Bending: Uses Exploit, Magnify and Distortion together to claim an area and rewrite its rules in their favor.

sequences.name: Frenzied Mage
abilities: Superiority: Converts legitimate rank, wealth and command into crushing pressure; the voice cows lesser beings and the body can grow giant.
Frenzy: Makes powers mutate unpredictably, usually improving the Mage's own while warping enemies' abilities into weak or absurd forms.
Frenzied Distortion: Bends projectiles mid-flight and hijacks a target's intent to move so they cannot stop themselves.

sequences.name: Duke of Entropy
abilities: Entropy: The longer a fight lasts, the more random a foe's powers, thoughts and surroundings become, until they collapse entirely.
Angelic Exploit: Pushes states, loopholes and distances to impossible extremes, such as one leap carrying them to the crimson moon.
Rule Distortion: Twists rules set by other authorities and bends them to the Duke's will.

sequences.name: Prince of Abolition
abilities: Redefinition: Redefines what counts as a bribe, an identity, an authority or the original body, then bends order around that definition.
Abolition: Overturns or voids chosen laws and orders, replacing them through prepared definitions and superior standing.
Regional Isolation: Seals off a prepared region by redefining what counts as inside, outside, law and protection.

sequences.name: Black Emperor
abilities: Authority of Distortion: Twists underlying rules, causality and mystical links, turning entrances into exits or turning hostile power aside.
Corruption and Disorder: Spreads corruption and escalating chaos through minds, societies, powers and laws.
Autocracy: Makes every hierarchy and rule within their order serve the Emperor alone.
Undying Order: Can return from death so long as the order they built and their apotheosis arrangements survive.

sequences.name: Arbiter
abilities: Authority: Carries a commanding weight that makes people inclined to believe their words and follow their instructions.
Combat Training: Gains a sturdier body and solid fighting skills for handling sudden violence.
Composure of Order: Stays calm under pressure and instinctively works to uphold the existing order.

sequences.name: Sheriff
abilities: Jurisdiction: Claims an area as their territory and senses crime and anything unusual happening inside it.
Recognition: After seeing someone in person or in a picture, can mystically sense that person, making fugitives hard to lose.
Investigative Instinct: Sharpened intuition and spiritual perception help track suspects and notice clues.
Weapon Mastery: Handles revolvers, shotguns and melee weapons with practiced confidence.

sequences.name: Interrogator
abilities: Psychic Piercing: Fires spiritual lightning from the eyes that bypasses flesh and wounds the soul within a few meters.
Whip of Pain: A thorny current lashes the target's consciousness, wearing down resistance and drawing out the truth.
Psychic Lashing: Wraps a weapon in spectral lightning so it can harm spirits and incorporeal beings.
Spectral Torture Tools: Summons ghostly instruments that injure the spirit body on contact.
Weapons and Demolition: Gains expertise with a wide range of weapons and with explosives.

sequences.name: Judge
abilities: Verdict: Speaks rules in Ancient Hermes that everything in the surrounding area must obey.
Prohibition: Forbids chosen actions or powers in an area, such as flight, invisibility, teleportation or entering the spirit world.
Imprisonment and Exile: Verdicts that pin a target in place, seal off an area, or banish a foe from it.
Flogging and Death: Verdicts of direct punishment, from painful spiritual lashes to an outright death sentence against weaker foes.
Judicial Presence: An unsettling aura makes people avoid their gaze, and their jurisdiction can grow toward city size.

sequences.name: Disciplinary Paladin
abilities: Punishment: Marks a person or thing as an offender, gaining strength and precise, hard-to-dodge strikes against it.
Overawing Authority: An aura of dread slows nearby foes and pressures them to bow their heads and obey.
Layered Prohibitions: Stacks several prohibitions on one area or target at the same time.
Paladin's Discipline: Body, intuition and self-control all strengthen, resisting attempts to pry into their mind.

sequences.name: Imperative Mage
abilities: Imperatives: Issues commands that become binding rules on a target's existence and cannot simply be disobeyed.
Weaken Mysticism, Strengthen Reality: Suppresses supernatural effects in an area while boosting the mundane, or does the reverse.
Contracts: Binds a target's body and spirit body to agreements that follow the world's rules.
Deprivation: Strips a target of one chosen power for a time.

sequences.name: Chaos Hunter
abilities: Chaos Detection: Senses, tracks and corrects disorder such as curses, possessions, disguises and restless undead.
Sword of Judgment: Delivers a near-unavoidable judgment that hits harder the more disorder a target carries.
Early Balance: Partitions a battlefield and imposes order on it, though that order can slide back into chaos.
Answer Prayers: Can hear and respond to prayers from within a certain range.

sequences.name: Balancer
abilities: Balance: Equalizes a conflict by excluding excessive power and outside help, splitting battles into roughly fair fights.
Laws: Enacts several decrees at once, applying multiple prohibitions or enhancements instantly.
Imbalance Sight: Detects hidden people and tricks through the imbalance they create.
Brass Pillar Form: Gains a complete angelic form, a colossal brass pillar inscribed with rules.

sequences.name: Hand of Order
abilities: Order Authority: Establishes, alters or removes non-fundamental rules across a battlefield, a city or a small nation.
Order Proxy: Borrows authorization from a deity or greater order to enforce rules beyond their own strength, at serious risk.
Order Perception: Senses every change in law and supernatural order within their domain and suppresses anomalies.

sequences.name: Justiciar
abilities: Divine Order: Lays down rules, removes lesser ones and adjusts how parts of reality operate.
Divine Judgment: Decides who has broken the law and imposes the consequences.
Absolute Prohibition: Suppresses powers, identities, connections, movement or entire phenomena.
Balance and Disorder: Equalizes any conflict and can restore, extinguish or deliberately create disorder.

pathways.name: Savant
pathways.speedNote: Moves faster through devices and constructs than on foot.

sequences.name: Savant
abilities: Perfect Recall: Remembers everything they have read, seen or experienced.
Engineering Mastery: Quickly grasps machines, firearms and lab equipment, repairing and improving them beyond normal standards.
Rapid Learning: Absorbs mathematics, physics, chemistry and technical crafts at remarkable speed.

sequences.name: Archaeologist
abilities: Historical Insight: Reads an object's age, origin, purpose and dangers from its construction, wear, symbols and spiritual traces.
Ruin Lore: Knows ancient languages, lost cultures and the taboos and traps hidden in ruins.
Field Hardiness: Gains a sturdy body and survival skills for long expeditions in the wild.

sequences.name: Appraiser
abilities: Appraisal: Quickly works out the properties, activation and drawbacks of most mystical items without divination.
Authentication: Spots forgeries, hidden damage, contamination and an item's true worth.
Safe Handling: Uses unfamiliar sealed artifacts while sidestepping much of their negative side effects.

sequences.name: Artisan
abilities: Crafting: Builds mystical items and Beyonder weapons from characteristics, spiritual materials, symbols and machinery.
Artifact Repair: Mends damaged mystical items, changes how they activate and reduces some of their drawbacks.
Advanced Machinery: Designs mechanical devices well beyond the technology of the era.

sequences.name: Astronomer
abilities: Astronomy: Understands celestial phenomena well enough to draw power and guidance from the stars.
False Starry Sky: Projects a fake sky of constellations that misleads astrology and other divination.
Star of Curses: Condenses starlight into rays that weaken, mutate or injure a target.
Star Blessing: Uses absorbed starlight to change gravity for a chosen target or area.
Celestial Calculation: Precisely computes trajectories, distances and timing for navigation and targeting.

sequences.name: Alchemist
abilities: Transmutation: Reshapes and converts materials, alloys and energy with extreme precision.
Life Alchemy: Creates artificial life such as golems, mechanical creatures and altered plants, and can give objects limited intelligence.
Elixirs: Brews alchemical concoctions that strengthen allies or weaken enemies.

sequences.name: Arcane Scholar
abilities: Body of Knowledge: Transforms into a form made of knowledge for anywhere from minutes to days.
Environment Analysis: Extracts precise information from the surroundings to reconstruct what happened there.
