Life Absorption: Drains vitality from living things across a vast radius.
Disassembly Ray: Fires a beam of light that breaks down the structure of most objects.
Arcane Technology: Translates observed powers into reproducible machines, rituals and artifacts.

sequences.name: Knowledge Magister
abilities: Teaching: Pours knowledge and skills into others, or strips learned skills away from them.
Analysis: Breaks any power, object or phenomenon down to its working principles and designs counters to it.
Enlightenment: Sparks sudden understanding in a target, granting temporary mastery of a field.
Rapid Creation: Turns complex designs into working creations far faster and awakens intelligence in machines.

sequences.name: Illuminator
abilities: Civilization: Holds authority over civilization, seeing a society's potential and the inventions it needs next.
Illumination: Inspires discoveries and speeds education so communities leap centuries ahead.
Collective Mastery: Temporarily grants whole communities the knowledge and coordination for immense projects.

sequences.name: Paragon
abilities: Divine Creation: Creates artifacts, machines, cities and artificial beings that would otherwise take whole civilizations.
Authority of Knowledge: Commands practical knowledge and learning, teaching or dissecting anything down to its principles.
Technology Command: Awakens, suppresses, repairs, transforms or absorbs machinery and crafted objects.
Progress: Accelerates invention and turns industry, transport and institutions into extensions of their will.

sequences.name: Mystery Pryer
abilities: Eyes of Mystery Prying: Sees spirituality, auras and normally invisible things, and spots the flaws in illusions and dreams.
Mystical Knowledge: Holds broad occult knowledge, with new insights sometimes arriving unbidden.
Quick Rituals: Performs ritual magic, charms and divination quickly and with few materials.
Heightened Spirituality: Spirituality rises sharply, fuelling rituals and sharpening intuition.

sequences.name: Melee Scholar
abilities: Combat Prying: Studies the principles behind fighting styles and weapons to master them quickly and read opponents.
Strengthened Body: Body becomes sturdier, with faster reactions for close combat.

sequences.name: Warlock
abilities: Spellcraft: Designs their own spells, such as fire, ice, lightning, wind, barriers or curses, from phenomena they understand.
Witchcraft: Brews potions and makes mystical items more effectively than before.
Analytical Eyes: Studies blood, remnants and artifacts to extract symbols for new spells.
Danger Sense: Greater spirituality gives sharp warnings of approaching danger.

sequences.name: Scrolls Professor
abilities: Scroll Making: Stores spells in prepared scrolls, released instantly by reading a word and burning them.
Shared Scrolls: Hands scrolls to allies so even non-casters can use spells.
Ready Casting: Scrolls let them cast when short on time or spirituality, skipping ritual delays.
Scroll Teleport: Reads a prepared scroll to flash a short distance away in an instant.

sequences.name: Constellations Master
abilities: Starlight Cage: Brings streams of starlight down on a target to imprison it.
Star Pillar: Merges conjured stars into a pillar of radiance that blasts an area.
Stellar Self: Dissolves the body into starlight particles to avoid harm and reform through gaps.
Star Concealment: Covers an area with stars that block outside sight and interference.
Starlight Works: Forms walkable bridges of starlight, lifts ships into the air or lights up darkness.

sequences.name: Mysticologist
abilities: Mystical Re-enactment: Recreates effects from myths, legends and secret history; the less known the secret, the stronger the result.
Mystical Analysis: Dissects rituals and strange phenomena piece by piece to learn how they work.
Deep Prying: Eyes of Mystery Prying now uncover far more hidden objects and properties.
Whisper Resistance: Better withstands the maddening knowledge and voices that press on Hermit Beyonders.

sequences.name: Clairvoyant
abilities: Prying Authority: Mystery Prying becomes a true authority, reaching secrets far beyond normal limits.
Prophecy: Glimpses likely consequences, favorable choices and scenes from the past.
Answer Prayers: Can hear and respond to prayers from within a certain range.

sequences.name: Sage
abilities: Information Form: Becomes flowing knowledge and symbols, passing through obstacles and rebuilding after partial destruction.
Removal and Revision: Deletes or rewrites knowledge, deciding what others are able to know.
Teaching: Forces knowledge into a mind; an overload can stun, corrupt or kill.
Secret Prophecy: Prying into secrets sharpens prophecy, revealing future fragments as enemies make their moves.

sequences.name: Knowledge Emperor
abilities: Knowledge as Power: Folds fully understood Beyonder powers into their informational body to produce matching effects.
Information Control: Gathers, removes, forges or hides information through the spirit world and mystical links.
Overwhelming Teaching: Floods a mind with crushing or useless knowledge.
Forbidden Prying: Can probe secrets of gods and Great Old Ones, though at great risk.

sequences.name: Hermit
abilities: Authority of Mysteries: Exposes almost any secret and treats the spirit world as a vast information network.
Information Transformation: Turns beings, objects and worlds into information to copy, alter, delete or restore.
Divine Hiding: Erases traces so thoroughly that even gods struggle to find them.
Divine Teaching: Instantly injects knowledge or change into connected Hermit Beyonders.

pathways.name: Monster
pathways.speedNote: Luck-driven dodging rather than raw speed.

sequences.name: Monster
abilities: Fate Perception: Senses danger, malice and shifts in luck, sometimes catching a glimpse of what is coming.
Strong Intuition: Receives warnings as visions, feelings or sudden urges to avoid a place or action.
Spirit Sensitivity: Extremely keen spiritual perception lets them hear and see what others miss.

sequences.name: Robot
abilities: Precise Calculation: Computes probabilities, trajectories and patterns with machine-like accuracy.
Emotional Control: Suppresses panic and hides reactions, staying coldly rational under pressure.
Divination Mastery: Becomes skilled at divination and at shielding themselves from others' divination.
Physical Boost: All physical abilities noticeably improve.

sequences.name: Lucky One
abilities: Passive Luck: Good fortune arrives on its own, from finding money to enemy attacks going astray.
Lucky Breaks: Useful coincidences, timely discoveries and narrow escapes happen far more often than chance allows.

sequences.name: Calamity Priest
abilities: Calamity Sense: Detects approaching disasters and misfortune building around people or places.
Calamity Attraction: Draws disasters toward their body and unleashes them on enemies, though they can strike the Priest too.
Mind Storm: Strikes an enemy's spirit body directly, leaving them sick and disoriented.
Calamity Transfer: Ritually shifts part of a coming disaster onto another person, object or place.

sequences.name: Winner
abilities: Luck Control: Starts actively steering their own fortune, building it up before battles, gambles or escapes.
Misfortune Curse: Places limited bad luck on an enemy, from missed shots to stumbling into danger.
Winning Foresight: Senses the best timing and choice, and excels at divination and counter-divination.

sequences.name: Misfortune Mage
abilities: Misfortune Field: Curses everyone within a circle of roughly 100 to 300 meters with bad luck.
Deadly Misfortune: A stronger curse of ill fortune that can endanger a target's life.
Blessing: Grants good luck to one or more targets, paid from their own luck or borrowed from the target's future.
Mercury Body: Their body naturally resists divination and prophecy aimed at them.
Fate Sense: Reliably feels shifts in fate and the presence of beings of higher rank.

sequences.name: Chaoswalker
abilities: Tangled Fate: Perceives the chaotic strands of fate and can steer clear of them or seal them away.
Probability Turbulence: Throws plans, attacks and divinations into chaos so outcomes become unpredictable.
Spirit Baptism: Purifies a target's spirit, calming its disorder and making it stable.

sequences.name: Soothsayer
abilities: Prophecy: Sees branching futures and pivotal choices, delivering high-level prophecies.
Fate Authority: Grants fortune, imposes angel-level misfortune or places an opportunity at an exact moment.
Fate Links: Senses and uses the connections between things and a person's fate.
Dreams and Mirrors: Reaches through the spirit world to influence dreams and mirrors.

sequences.name: Snake of Mercury
abilities: Reboot: Resets a target or area to an earlier state, healing wounds or undoing recent events.
Reincarnation: Escapes death by restarting their own life cycle through a prepared rebirth.
River of Fate: Perceives and manipulates the currents of fate linking people, events and eras.

sequences.name: Wheel of Fortune
abilities: Authority of Fate: Rewrites how causes, choices and outcomes connect, granting great fortune or cascading failure.
Divine Reboot: Resets vast regions, events or states to an earlier point in a cycle.
Eternal Cycle: Persists through repeating eras, prepared vessels and descendants.
Chosen Future: Favors one branch of the future until it becomes reality.
